subject.title: Voice transcript recovery turn generates response but delivery-mirror drops Telegram reply

question: Is the current live report enough to authorize a focused Telegram recovery/delivery investigation, or should this wait for a current-main live repro with redacted Telegram logs and session evidence?
rationale: The issue is plausible and high impact, but the inspected source does not identify a single safe repair boundary and no linked PR owns this exact failure mode.

options.title: Request current-main proof first
options.body: Keep this open and ask for a current-main live Telegram repro or redacted logs that show generated recovery content, delivery accounting, and the missing Telegram send.

options.title: Sponsor a maintainer investigation
options.body: Assign an owner to reproduce the async voice transcript recovery flow with Telegram Desktop proof and inspect recovery correlation, queueing, and fallback accounting together.

options.title: Fold into a broader delivery project
options.body: Track it with related delivery-loss work only if maintainers decide the remaining reports share one recovery/final-delivery root cause.

recommendation.title: Request current-main proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this open and ask for a current-main live Telegram repro or redacted logs that show generated recovery content, delivery accounting, and the missing Telegram send.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work in queued follow-up and final-reply delivery is closest to the cross-cutting recovery/delivery boundary that needs proof.
